blocks.title: Definition of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Students should understand the definition of machine learning as a field that enables computers to learn without being explicitly programmed.

blocks.title: Applications of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Students should understand real-world applications of machine learning, including smart assistants, advertising, and electrical load prediction.
blocks.transitionIntention: build on Definition of Machine Learning

blocks.title: Why Machine Learning is Useful
blocks.teachingObjective: Students should understand the reasons for using machine learning, including high efficiency, cognitive science insights, and system customization.
blocks.transitionIntention: build on Definition of Machine Learning

blocks.title: Big Picture of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Students should understand the big picture of machine learning, including its relation to artificial intelligence and the process of teaching computers to learn
blocks.transitionIntention: build on Definition of Machine Learning

blocks.title: Supervised Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Students should understand supervised learning, including regression and classification, and be able to recognize examples of each.
blocks.transitionIntention: build on Big Picture of Machine Learning

blocks.title: Unsupervised Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Students should understand unsupervised learning, including clustering and dimensionality reduction, and be able to recognize examples of each.
blocks.transitionIntention: build on Big Picture of Machine Learning

blocks.title: Reinforcement Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Students should understand reinforcement learning, including how intelligent agents learn from feedback in an environment.
blocks.transitionIntention: build on Big Picture of Machine Learning

blocks.title: Generalized Machine Learning Framework
blocks.teachingObjective: Students should understand the generalized framework of machine learning, including input, output, target functions, and the components of ML algorithms.
blocks.transitionIntention: build on Supervised Learning, Unsupervised Learning, Reinforcement Learning
